subject: Partner-led discovery: next steps & demo scheduling (CloudBridge / FinServCo)
messages:
From: Alex Simmons <alex.simmons@cloudbridge.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>; Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Javier Mendez <javier.mendez@finservco.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + next steps: CloudBridge x FinServCo partnership discovery

Hi Marissa / Camila —

Thanks again for joining the call this morning. Quick recap from CloudBridge + FinServCo sides and proposed next steps: 

What we heard:
- FinServCo is evaluating marketplace and SaaS distribution via CloudBridge for their internal customer-facing AI features. Key constraints: P95 inference latency target ~300ms, need private deployment option for regulated data.
- Primary integration work: marketplace listing + SSO, billing integration, and a short technical validation for inference performance on a representative workload.

Recommended next step:
- Technical deep dive / joint demo (CloudBridge + Redwood + FinServCo engineering) to walk through integration points and run a short performance validation.

Proposed times (PT):
- Wed 22 Jul — 10:00–11:00 AM PT
- Thu 23 Jul — 02:00–03:00 PM PT

Can you confirm which of these works for Redwood and FinServCo? If neither, please propose alternative windows. I attached a short integration notes doc and our marketplace checklist for reference.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate invites once we lock a time.

Best,
Alex Simmons
Head of Partnerships, CloudBridge
alex.simmons@cloudbridge.io
+1 (415) 555-0189

Attachments: cloudbridge_integration_notes.pdf (application/pdf), marketplace_checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Simmons <alex.simmons@cloudbridge.io>; Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Javier Mendez <javier.mendez@finservco.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + next steps: CloudBridge x FinServCo partnership discovery

Alex — thanks for the clear recap. Appreciate CloudBridge driving this.

Both times look doable on our side; Mateo (cc'd on calendar invite below) will lead the technical portion from Redwood. Quick asks before the deep dive so we can come prepared:
- Can FinServCo confirm the representative model/sequence lengths you want us to validate and an example dataset profile?
- Are there any specific compliance requirements (e.g., customer-managed keys, region restrictions) we should include in the agenda?

My preferred time is Wed 22 Jul 10:00 AM PT. If that works for everyone I’ll ask Camila to send a calendar invite and I’ll attach a mutual action plan for the meeting.

Proposed agenda (30–45 min):
1) Intros + success criteria (5 min)
2) Integration overview & marketplace flow (10 min)
3) Technical validation plan + perf targets (15 min)
4) Next steps & responsibilities (5–10 min)

I’m attaching a short mutual_action_plan.xlsx and our redwood_overview.pdf for FinServCo to skim before the call.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (510) 555-0123

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), redwood_overview.pdf (application/pdf)
